floor_note: The floor and the golden truth read one measures table, so the floor's row is the ceiling for the families it was written for, not a fair competitor; a model is listed as beating the floor only when its interval clears the floor's.

not_measured.daily budget: the floor has no budget; a model's live share at half, as set and double its budget is printed with its row
not_measured.retrieval depth: measured on the floor only (definition family), by scripts/interior_depth.py
not_measured.summarization threshold: the golden set has no multi turn question, so the threshold never fires in the eval

judge.reason: the clarity judge needs a model key; it runs only from cassettes in CI and within budget live
